sidecar.vt.session_start.description: The service started and accepts clients.

sidecar.vt.client_connect.description: A client authenticated; owner is the name it gave.

sidecar.vt.session_open.description: A terminal session started; the line names it in session. cwd and pid are present when known.

sidecar.vt.session_exit.description: The child of a session was reaped; status is the exit status.

sidecar.vt.pty_eof.description: The read side of the PTY of a session ended.

sidecar.vt.pty_read_error.description: Reading the PTY of a session failed.

sidecar.vt.pty_write.description: Bytes written to the PTY of a session, all of them, with the cids of the inputs that caused the write. error is present when the write failed.

sidecar.vt.pty_read.description: Bytes read from the PTY of a session, all of them.

sidecar.vt.request.description: A request line of a client with its whole body, written when its handling ended; a line that is not JSON is body.unparsed.

sidecar.vt.frame.description: An image frame of a surface was drawn.

sidecar.vt.consumed_wait.description: The time from sending a frame to the answer of the host.

sidecar.vt.read_wait.description: The read side of a connection waited one second or more for data.

sidecar.vt.output_blocked.description: Writing a line to a client took 10 milliseconds or more.

sidecar.vt.record.error.description: An error that the service reports to its operator.

sidecar.vt.record.info.description: A fact that the service reports to its operator.
